title: Wideband Backscatter Radar Target
text: Backscatter wideband signals from radar target, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Azimuth angles (deg)} sets Azimuth angles; {Backscatter pattern frequency vector (Hz)} sets the wideband backscatter pattern frequencies, {Elevation angles (deg)} sets the elevation angles, {RCS pattern (m^2)} sets the radar cross-section pattern ones, {Fluctuation model} sets the target fluctuation model, {Propagation speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {Operating frequency (Hz)} sets the signal carrier frequency 300.0e6, {Inherit sample rate}, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sampling rate, {Number of subbands} sets the number of processing subbands and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X
ports.summary: Wideband incident nonpolarized signal N -by- 1 complex-valued vector | N -by- M complex-valued matrix

ports.name: Ang
ports.summary: Incident signal direction 2-by-1 real-valued column vector | 2-by- M real-valued column matrix

ports.name: Update
ports.summary: Switch to update RCS false | true

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Narrowband reflected signal 1-by- M complex-valued vector | N -by- M complex-valued matrix

params.name: Backscatter pattern frequency vector (Hz)
params.values: Wideband backscatter pattern frequencies [0,1e20] (default) | real-valued row vector of positive values in strictly increasing order

params.name: Azimuth angles (deg)
params.values: Azimuth angles [-180:180] (default) | 1-by- P real-valued row vector | P -by-1 real-valued column vector

params.name: Elevation angles (deg)
params.values: Elevation angles [-90:90] (default) | 1-by- Q real-valued row vector | Q -by-1 real-valued column vector

params.name: RCS pattern (m^2)
params.values: Radar cross-section pattern ones(181,361) (default) | Q -by- P real-valued matrix | Q -by- P -by- K real-valued array | 1-by- P -by- K real-valued array | K -by- P real-valued matrix

params.name: Fluctuation model
params.values: Target fluctuation model Nonfluctuating (default) | Swerling1 | Swerling2 | Swerling3 | Swerling4

params.name: Propagation speed (m/s)
params.values: Signal propagation speed physconst(’LightSpeed’) (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Operating frequency (Hz)
params.values: Signal carrier frequency 300.0e6 (default) | positive real-valued scalar

params.name: Inherit sample rate
params.values: Inherit sample rate from upstream blocks on (default) | off

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sampling rate of signal 1e6 (default) | positive real-valued scalar

params.name: Number of subbands
params.values: Number of processing subbands 64 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
